title: Backend API: AiProctoringViolationEvent
description: Payload emitted by clip_upload_service.py to the LMS backend API after a violation clip is processed. The backend stores this against the exam attempt's violation record.
authentication: Authorization: Bearer <access_token> (from OS keychain, loaded by Python bridge auth module)

evidenceUrl.description: CDN-hosted URL of the uploaded clip. Omitted or null when uploadStatus != 'success'.

reasonCode.description: Machine-readable failure reason. Omitted or null on success.

captureWindowStart.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Derived from first pre-violation buffer chunk timestamp.

captureWindowEnd.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Derived from last post-violation chunk timestamp.

primaryViolationType.description: Alert code of the violation that originally triggered the capture.

primaryConfidence.description: Detection confidence of the triggering violation (0.0–1.0 float).

description.description: Human-readable summary. E.g.: 'Phone detected in frame + 2 additional violations in clip'.

allViolations.description: All violation events captured within the clip's time window.

exampleRequest.description: Phone detected in frame + 1 additional violation in clip

allViolations.description: Gaze away from screen (detected by local model)

202.description: Accepted. Backend has queued the violation record for persistence.

400.description: Bad request. Invalid payload (e.g., missing required field).

401.description: Unauthorized. Bearer token invalid or expired.

500.description: Internal server error. Python bridge should log and not retry the backend call.

notes: The endpoint path POST /api/Proctoring/violation-clip is provisional. Adjust to match the LMS API once the backend endpoint is defined.
The Python bridge must include the Authorization Bearer token from the OS keychain, following the same auth pattern as other Python bridge API calls (auth.py).
This contract does not define the backend database schema — only the API payload shape.
